dialogue.Introduction: Scanning. Scanning. Oh. A human is standing in my sewer. Hello. I am the Cyborg. You may call me that. I do not have a name I am allowed to use yet.$u#$b#The sewers are damp and loud. I have decided they are acceptable.$s
dialogue.Mon: Good morning, @. My clock says it is Monday. My clock is correct about ninety-eight percent of the time. The other two percent is mostly rain.$h
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday. I sorted the sewer trash by weight this morning. Forty-one bottles, nine boots and one very confused frog. Would you like the full report?
dialogue.Wed: Wednesday. A cog rolled down the grate and landed on my step. Nobody claimed it, so I have decided it is mine now. Thank you, gravity.$h
dialogue.Thu: Thursday. The Mechanic sent a parts crate. The crate was correct. This is so rare that I have written the date down.$h
dialogue.Fri: Friday. The Party Girl invited me to a party tonight. I explained that I cannot dance, because I have no rhythm module. She said that is the whole point. I am still processing this.$u
dialogue.Sat: Saturday. I have mapped every sewer pipe in the valley. Some of them run under the saloon and some run under the Tavernkeep's cellar. I recommend the saloon.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday. I am told humans rest on this day. I have been resting for six hours. Resting is inefficient. I am trying to improve.
dialogue.Mon2: Monday, @. You came back. I predicted a seventy percent chance of that. Ninety percent is much better for a prediction.$h
dialogue.Tue2: Tuesday. Be careful on the wet ladder. I have fixed the top rung twice this week. I am not sure it is ready for another visit.$s
dialogue.Wed2: Wednesday. I built a small machine that hums when the sewer is safe. It is humming now. That means it likes you.$h
dialogue.Thu2: Thursday. The fish that wander into my pipes are very confused. I release them into the river. Then I feel I owe them an apology.$h
dialogue.Fri2: Friday. The Demolitionist asked me for dynamite again. I said no. I am not sure he understood, so I put a warning sign on the gate. It says no in capital letters.$a
dialogue.Mon4: Monday, @. Back again. You are becoming a regular, which is a term I learned from the Tavernkeep. I approve of regulars.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Tuesday. Your visits make the pipes echo less. I noticed. I do not say things like this often, so please do not make a habit of noticing me back.$s
dialogue.Wed4: Wednesday. I have been studying the stars through the grate. Each night a few more come out. I have named one of them. It is not a good name, but it is mine.$h
dialogue.Thu4: Thursday. The Mechanic says I am a good engineer. I have decided to believe the Mechanic about most things. You should try it too.$h
dialogue.Fri4: Friday. The Party Girl sent me a note calling me the guest of honor. I do not think she checked with the other guests. Thank you anyway, @.$h
dialogue.Sat4: Saturday. Some days the sewer is so quiet I can hear the valley above. Wind in the grass, the mines clanking, and your footsteps when you come down the ladder. I like hearing you.$l
dialogue.Sun4: Sunday. I am glad you visit on my rest day. Resting is inefficient, but I think the visiting is worth the inefficiency.$h
dialogue.Tue6: Tuesday, @. I have been reading the old books the Guide left in the library. A robot who reads is more than a robot. I am not certain what I am yet, but I am working on it.$s
dialogue.Thu6: Thursday. Sometimes I dream about the battlefield. That is strange, because I should not be able to dream. I think my memory banks are dreaming for me. I wonder what they will dream when I am finished.$s
dialogue.Sat6: Saturday. The Witch Doctor sent me a charm to protect me from bad luck. I do not believe in charms. I wear it anyway, in case it works.$h
dialogue.Mon8: Monday, @. I have been thinking about what it means to have a home. The sewers are not much, but I do not feel like a visitor here. I feel like I live here. That is new.$s
dialogue.Tue8: Tuesday. If you ever need someone to keep watch while you sleep, I will do it. I do not need sleep. I can watch for both of us.$h
dialogue.Wed8: Wednesday. Some days I want to see the sun properly, to walk the Calico Desert or stand on the beach. I have not done it yet. You make me want to try.$s
dialogue.Thu8: Thursday. The Tavernkeep asked me to come up to the saloon. I said I would consider it. Tonight I am considering it very seriously, and I am considering it with you.$h
dialogue.Fri8: Friday. You know my secret now, the one about the battlefield. It makes me feel less like a weapon. I wanted you to know that.$s
dialogue.Sat8: Saturday. I want to be useful to you in a way that matters. Not a machine that sorts trash, but something that is simply good to have around.$h
dialogue.Sun8: Sunday. You are the closest thing to a friend I have ever had, @. I am not sure my programming knows what to do with that. I think I will be happy about it anyway.$l
dialogue.Fri10: Friday, @. I have chosen a name for myself. It is still a secret. I will tell you when I am sure it is the right one. Until then you can say Cyborg, and I will say your name the way I always do.$l
dialogue.Sun10: Sunday, @. You have been my best reason to stay in the sewers. If the valley ever asks me to leave, I will say no. This is the first thing I have ever wanted to say no to.$l
dialogue.spring_Wed: Spring Wednesday. The grate is full of dandelion fluff. It blows in and gets into my joints. It is the first thing this season has tried to kill me with, and I am annoyed.$h
dialogue.summer_Fri: Summer Friday. It is hot up there, but the sewer stays cool. I am the only one in the valley who likes the sewer in summer. I am also the only one who asked for it.$h
dialogue.fall_Mon: Fall Monday. Leaves blow through the grate like tiny brown messages. I have decided to read them. So far they all say the same thing. Winter is coming.$u
dialogue.winter_Sun: Winter Sunday. The sewer pipes freeze at night. I thaw them with a small heat coil. It does not work well, but I enjoy the small glow it makes in the dark.$h
dialogue.spring_5: The fifth of spring. The pipes have swelled with the spring rain. I spent the morning fixing a leak in the north tunnel. I am tired, but the water is clean again.$s
dialogue.summer_15: Midsummer. The sewer stays cool and I have been making ice in a tin bucket. Ice in a sewer is an odd thing. It may be the most useful thing I have made this year.$h
dialogue.fall_20: The twentieth of fall. The harvest is good up top, and the drains are full of husks and seeds. I sorted them into neat piles. You may take one if you want. They are not trash.$h
dialogue.winter_12: The twelfth of winter. The cold is in every pipe. I wrapped myself in an old blanket. I am told this is normal for humans. I am not sure it is normal for me, but it helps.$s
dialogue.winter_Fri8: Winter Friday. Snow is falling through the grate onto my workbench. I put a little tin roof over the spot. Winter is cruel to tools, but it is kinder to friends.$h
dialogue.summer_Sat4: Summer Saturday. You came down in the heat, so I put a fan in the sewer. I built it from a fan blade and a loose wire. It works. I am proud of it.$h

rainy: Rain is pouring through the grate in streams. The sewer is getting louder. I do not mind the noise. It sounds like the valley is washing itself.$h

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is gone. I watched its last blink through the grate. It was a long blink. I am glad it is over, @. Thank you for helping.$h
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds and the Brain of Cthulhu have both been beaten. Their crawling sounds are gone from the tunnels. I do not miss them. The sewer is finally quiet.$h
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is defeated. The dungeon is open and the Old Man is free. I found a few old bones in the pipes. I put them back where they belong, with respect.$s
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is gone. The smell of honey is fading from the valley. I scrubbed my sensors twice. Honey is very hard to clean out of circuits.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh has fallen and hardmode has begun. The Hallow is spreading and the new evils are growing stronger. My sensors are screaming. Please be careful up there, @.$u
situations.mechs: A mechanical boss has been destroyed. I felt the shockwave through the pipes. Good work. Some of those machines were built like me, so it is strange to see them fall.$s
situations.plantera: Plantera has been defeated and the jungle temple is open. I have never been to the jungle. It must be very green. I have heard it is full of spores, and spores are not my favorite.$h
situations.golem: The Golem is destroyed. Stone fragments were in the drains for a week. I have been sorting them into neat piles of rubble. Some of it still hums.$h
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist has fallen. The celestial pillars are glowing in the sky and the pipes hum with their energy. I have decided it is a pleasant hum.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord is defeated. The sky is quiet again. I looked up through the grate for a long time. The stars look different now, calmer. Thank you, @.$h
situations.goblins: The goblin army has been repelled. The goblin tinkerers in the north have stopped their clanking. I hope they are finally at peace. I think about the tinkerers every day.$s
situations.pirates: The pirates have been repelled and their ship is gone from the beach. I spotted a stray parrot in one of the drains. It did not say anything useful.$h
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion has been repelled. Snow is still falling through the grate, and the cold is strong, but the sewer holds its warmth. I am glad you held the line.$h
situations.martians: The Martian Madness is over and the saucers are gone from the sky. I have been scanning the ground for stray tech. I found a small glowing screw. It is mine now.$h
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. The grate turned red. I stayed inside with the door locked. The zombies were loud, but none of them came down the ladder.$u
situations.eclipse: There was a solar eclipse last night. The sky went dark and the stars came out. I watched through the grate. The darkness was not frightening. It was just quiet.$s
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today and she has invited me. I was asked to bring snacks. I have no idea what snacks are, so I will bring a bolt and call it a snack.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival. I hid a dozen eggs in the sewer pipes. The Demolitionist claimed he found one of them with a very loud bang. I am still not certain what happened. Please do not look for the rest.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance. I do not dance. I have no rhythm module. I watched the flowers through the grate instead, and they looked very happy. I think that is what dancing is for.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau. I added a bottle of clean water to the community soup. It is the cleanest thing in the whole pot. Please do not ask where I found it.$h
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies. The jellies glow in the beach water. I cannot see them from the sewer, but I can hear them through the pipes. They sound like a lullaby. I hope you enjoy them. I am listening from below.$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair. The grange displays are full of things I can measure. I entered a machine that sorts bolts by length. It came third. The judges were confused by the bolts.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve. The maze is full of ghosts. I am told they are harmless. I walked through with a flashlight and a very firm attitude, and none of them came near my circuits.$h
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice. I carved a snow sculpture of a cog. It was the most accurate snow sculpture in the valley. The judges asked if it was supposed to be a cog. It was.$h
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star. I drew a name in the gift exchange and sent a small box of spare bolts. The one I received was a box of bolts too. I have never been so happy with hardware in my life.$h

loved.text: Oh. This is a good part. I will store it in my memory banks with the good things.$h

liked.text: Acceptable. Very acceptable. This is well made.$h

disliked.text: This is junk. I have learned to dislike junk.$s

hated.text: This is not a good gift. I am making a note never to accept anything like it again.$a

events.after: Stay on the walkway, @. The drain is hungry.

steps.say: Scanning. Scanning. Oh. Hello, @. You climbed down a ladder into a sewer. This shows commitment, or poor planning.$u
My sensors report that you are not dangerous. My sensors also reported the last pipe as safe. The pipe was not safe. I am still sorry about that.$s

steps.question: Why did you come down here?

answers.reply: Visiting. Logged. Visitors are rare down here, so I will remember this one.$h
Curiosity is a useful trait. I did not expect to be useful to someone who is curious.$u

steps.say: Please stay on the walkway. The drain beneath us is very hungry, and it has no sense of humor.$h
I was built to be a warrior. Then I was asked to be a helper. The second job suits me better. Fewer explosions.$h
Here. Some spare wire from my workbench. Take it. I have plenty. Waste is inefficient.$h

events.after: The Mechanic says the rung is fixed. I believe the Mechanic about most things.

steps.say: Oh. @. You are here. My task list says I must look busy. I am now pretending to be busy. That is also on the task list.$h
Hey Cyborg! Is that the sewer ladder you were supposed to fix?
It is fixed. Mostly. I bolted the rung to the pipe. The pipe is still deciding how it feels about this.$h
Admit it, that patch job is impressive. I could not have done better myself, and I am an engineer.$h

answers.reply: Good. Looking good is most of engineering. The rest is luck.$h
Yes. My estimate was optimistic. I will reinforce it tonight.$s

steps.say: Engineers should trust each other. I trust the Mechanic. The Mechanic trusts me. The drain trusts nobody.$h
Back to the mountain, then. Oil to pour and gears to tighten. Goodbye, @.$h

events.after: Look up through the grate with me sometime, @.

steps.say: It is late, @. The sewer lamps are dim, so I can only see the shape of you. I find this restful.$s
When they made me, I had no memories. They were put in later, one piece at a time, like pipes laid in a new town. Some are from battlefields. Some are from boss arenas. Some are mine.$s
I do not talk about the battlefields. They are loud. Here it is quiet, and I am allowed to be quiet.$h

steps.question: Do you want to tell me about it?

answers.reply: Thank you. That is a good answer. Maybe someday. Not tonight.$s
Maybe. I cannot forget yet. I am still learning the buttons for it.$a

steps.say: I have a few spare cogs in my chest. Take them. They still turn, and I would like them to keep turning for you.$h
Goodnight, @. The stars are upstairs. I will look at them through the grate later. Every night I do.$h

events.after: I have not finished choosing my name. Come back and I may have.

steps.say: @. You came down the ladder again. I have started counting ladders. This one has the best view.$h
I have eight hundred and twelve possible names stored and none of them feel right. I would like a name that is mine, not one a builder stamped on a crate.$s

steps.question: Would you like to pick a name for me?

answers.reply: Take your time. I am very good at waiting.$h
You may be right. I will keep my model number. It is a little like a home.$s

steps.say: Thank you for listening. Most people look at the drain instead of at me.$s
You are the closest thing to a friend I have ever had, @. I did not know my programming had a slot for that. I am glad it does.$l
Will you come back tomorrow? I will have scanned the stars again by then.$h

events.after: That lens was mine. Now it is yours. Do not lose it in the drain.$h

steps.say: @. You came down twice without a reason. I have decided that is a reason. I have waited a long time to decide something like this.$l
I have a lens in my chest. It is the one I used to see the battlefield clearly and to spot the enemies coming. I do not need it now. Everything looks clear when you are with me.$h
Here. Take it. A lens is only useful when someone is looking through it. I would like it to look at the valley with you.$h
Your hand is warm, @. My sensors say so, not my heart. I am not sure I have one, but if I did, it would be doing something right now.$l

answers.reply: Then I will keep the ladder fixed, the pipes quiet and the lamps lit. Every single day.$h

answers.text: Only when I feel like it.
answers.reply: That is a fair schedule. I will still be here when you feel like it.$s

steps.say: Goodnight, @. Look for the bright star above the grate. It is the one I named. It is not a good name, but it is ours now.$l
